description:
Create a nonlegendary copy of Kodama of the East Tree using Irenicus's Vile Duplication (this may involve additional steps depending on the card used).
Play Oboro, Palace in the Clouds.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters, both Kodama of the East Trees and Oboro, Palace in the Clouds trigger.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Oboro, Palace in the Clouds trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the legendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Oboro, Palace in the Clouds onto the battlefield.
The nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree and Oboro, Palace in the Clouds trigger.
Resolve the Oboro, Palace in the Clouds trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree's trigger, putting Oboro, Palace in the Clouds onto the battlefield.
The legendary Kodama of the East Tree and Oboro, Palace in the Clouds trigger.
Repeat from step 5.
